dialogs.signOutAdminDescription: You'll need to sign in again to access this admin. Any unsaved work in this session will be lost.
dialogs.signOutDashboardDescription: You'll need to sign in again to access this tenant. Any unsaved work in this session will be lost.

profile.avatarDescription: Shown in the topbar and on your activity. Square crops work best — JPG, PNG, or WebP.
profile.adminIdentityDescription: Your account details. These are managed by an administrator — contact one if changes are needed.
profile.dashboardIdentityDescription: Your name and contact details, visible across the dashboard.
profile.emailChangeHelp: Contact your tenant admin to change your sign-in email.
profile.accountStatusDescription: Runtime flags on this account. Contact an operator to change them.
profile.subjectIdentifierDescription: The unique ID this account uses inside the platform. Read-only.

appearance.languageDescription: Choose the language and reading direction used across this app.
appearance.adminThemeDescription: Console looks good in both modes — the editorial-terminal language is built around tone-neutral surfaces with a single chartreuse accent that reads identically on either.
appearance.dashboardThemeDescription: Pick a colour mode for the dashboard. System follows your OS.
appearance.adminDensityDescription: Compact mode will reduce card padding and row height for data-dense screens — similar to the dashboard's density toggle.
appearance.darkBlurb: Console-default. Lower glare for long sessions.
